pairing: Within each domain-size-topology-rho-seed condition all policies reuse the same initial state, heterogeneous parameter draw and exogenous innovation stream. No state or random stream is shared across domains.

task_endpoints.uav6dof: tracking, inter-UAV separation, attitude and energy margin
task_endpoints.vehicle: dynamic headway, speed tracking, acceleration and string-amplification margin
task_endpoints.motor: speed tracking, current and energy margin
task_endpoints.robot: formation tracking and inter-robot separation margin

claim_boundary: New theory-led, domain-specific heterogeneous computational interventions. They are not source-model reproductions, HIL, hardware experiments or physical causal evidence.
